programs.summary: Providing accessible healthcare, mobile clinics, and preventative medical camps to underserved rural communities.
programs.description: Our flagship healthcare initiative bridges the gap between critical medical services and marginalized populations. We operate regular diagnostic camps, provide free essential medications, and conduct widespread awareness campaigns on polio eradication and child hygiene.
programs.title: Healthcare & Medical Relief
programs.problem_addressed: Rural villages lack accessible primary health centers, resulting in untreated chronic illnesses and high maternal and child mortality.
programs.geographical_coverage: Odisha, Jharkhand, and border districts across eastern India.

programs.summary: Empowering children and youth through foundational learning kits, digital literacy, and job-oriented vocational training.
programs.description: Education is the most sustainable antidote to generational poverty. SCNSWF supports government schools, distributes high-quality study materials, runs after-school learning centers, and trains youth in market-relevant vocational skills.
programs.title: Quality Education & Skill Development
programs.problem_addressed: Severe school dropout rates after primary grades and youth unemployability due to lack of practical vocational skills.
programs.geographical_coverage: Semi-urban slums and remote tribal educational clusters.

programs.summary: Fostering financial independence through micro-enterprise coaching, self-help groups (SHGs), and leadership workshops.
programs.description: We organize rural women into self-help groups, providing seed capital guidance, artisan handicraft training, and financial literacy to foster true autonomy and gender equity.
programs.title: Women Empowerment & Self-Reliance
programs.problem_addressed: Women facing financial dependence, lack of credit access, and low economic participation in rural economies.

programs.summary: Rapid response emergency supplies, cyclone shelters, winter clothing distribution, and geriatric support.
programs.description: When natural catastrophes strike or severe winter winds arrive, our field volunteers deploy immediately with dry rations, water purification kits, hygiene packs, and temporary shelter rehabilitation.
programs.title: Disaster Relief & Community Welfare
programs.problem_addressed: Vulnerability of coastal and riverine families to cyclones, floods, and seasonal extremes.
programs.geographical_coverage: High-risk coastal flood and cyclone belts.

impactStories.summary: How our mobile medical unit helped save dozens of high-risk pregnancies and provided chronic diabetes care.
impactStories.body: In early 2025, our mobile healthcare team reached the dense forest hamlets of Kalahandi. Over 600 villagers received direct medical consultations, free prescription glasses, and vital insulin treatment.
impactStories.title: Bringing Lifesaving Healthcare to Kalahandi Villages

impactStories.summary: Sunita overcame acute resource constraints through SCNSWF after-school mentoring and scholarship.
impactStories.body: Sunita, daughter of daily-wage agricultural workers, became the first girl from her village to qualify for the State Engineering Diploma entrance exam with full tuition sponsorship.
impactStories.title: From Tribal Settlement to State Polytechnic: Sunita’s Journey
